cfg_rescale.description: APG norm rescale toward vt_pos magnitude. Only applied when rcfg_mode != 'off'.

feedback_depth.description: Feedback delay-tap depth in ticks (1 = last, N = N ticks back)

guidance_scale.description: RCFG guidance scale. Only applied when rcfg_mode != 'off'.

rcfg_mode.description: Residual-CFG mode. String-valued; set via the set_rcfg_mode tool, not set_knob.

seed.description: Stream seed (uint32 integer; passed to torch.manual_seed)

shift.description: Flow shift (timing/curve shape). Passed verbatim to the diffusion solver.

steps_override.description: Diffusion step count. Lower = lower quality, higher = more latency. Changing rebuilds the StreamPipeline.

x0_target.description: Scalar blend toward the x0 source-lock target (second half of the schedule). Requires a source latent.

cfg_rescale.description: APG norm rescale toward vt_pos magnitude. Only applied when rcfg_mode != 'off'.

feedback_depth.description: Feedback delay-tap depth in ticks (1 = last, N = N ticks back)

guidance_scale.description: RCFG guidance scale. Only applied when rcfg_mode != 'off'.

rcfg_mode.description: Residual-CFG mode. String-valued; set via the set_rcfg_mode tool, not set_knob.

sde_amp.description: SDE diffusion amplitude (replaces denoise in SDE mode)

seed.description: Stream seed (uint32 integer; passed to torch.manual_seed)

shift.description: Flow shift (timing/curve shape). Passed verbatim to the diffusion solver.

steps_override.description: Diffusion step count. Lower = lower quality, higher = more latency. Changing rebuilds the StreamPipeline.

x0_target.description: Scalar blend toward the x0 source-lock target (second half of the schedule). Requires a source latent.

clear_structure_source.description: Drop the structure override; restore the source's own context_latent. Acked by structure_cleared.

clear_timbre_source.description: Drop the timbre override; fall back to self-timbre. Acked by timbre_cleared.

disable_lora.description: Disable a LoRA and drop its lora_str_<id> knob.

enable_lora.description: Enable a LoRA; allocates a lora_str_<id> knob.

strength.description: Target strength the refit lands at.

loop_band.description: Arm / move / clear the playback loop band.

end_sec.description: Loop end in seconds; null/degenerate clears.

start_sec.description: Loop start in seconds; null/degenerate clears.

manual_slot_add.description: Allocate the next manual steering slot (LIFO); allocates its four man_*_<N> knobs. Echoed back as manual_slot_count on success AND refusal (at manual_slot_cap).

manual_slot_pop.description: Remove the highest-numbered manual steering slot and drop its man_*_<N> knobs (LIFO; interior deletion is not supported). Echoed back as manual_slot_count on success AND refusal (empty registry).

params.description: Continuous parameter update; sent every tick (~125 Hz) carrying the full knob dict.

playback_pos.description: Playhead position in SECONDS (not a 0..1 ratio); used for time-keyed curve sampling.

raw.description: Knob name -> value map. The payload schema is the separate /api/knobs manifest; values are clamped/validated server-side.

tags.description: Prompt A (wire text; enabled-LoRA triggers are prepended client-side).

tags_b.description: Optional prompt B, cached for A/B blend.

set_depth.description: Live pipeline_depth retune. Echoed back as depth_applied.

value.description: Target ring depth; clamped to [1, max_pipeline_depth].

set_interp_method.description: Switch a blend path between slerp (norm-preserving) and linear.

set_prompt_blend.description: Lerp cached prompt A/B conditioning. Cheap; no encode pass.

set_structure_fixture.description: Use a server-side fixture as the structure reference (no upload round-trip).

set_structure_source.description: Upload audio as the structure (semantic-hint) reference. JSON header followed by one binary PCM frame: ``<II`` (channels, samples) then interleaved float32 at 48 kHz. Acked by structure_set / structure_failed.

set_timbre_fixture.description: Use a server-side fixture as the timbre reference (no upload round-trip).

set_timbre_source.description: Upload audio as the timbre reference. JSON header followed by one binary PCM frame: ``<II`` (channels, samples) then interleaved float32 at 48 kHz. Acked by timbre_set / timbre_failed.

set_timbre_strength.description: Blend the cached (silence, full) timbre conditioning pair.

value.description: 1.0 = full reference, 0.0 = silence baseline. Clamped to [0,1].

swap_source.description: Replace the playback source in-flight. A binary PCM frame follows UNLESS use_server_source is set. Acked by swap_ready (+ binary buffer) / swap_failed.

fixture_name.description: Source label; for server-side loads, the fixture/upload name to read off the pod's disk.

stem_source_mode.description: For uploads: which model-ripped stem feeds inference.

use_server_source.description: When true, the server loads the named source off its own disk and NO binary frame is sent.

write_audio.description: Write audio onto the live source in place — the 'play into the model' path, NO song restart / playhead reset / BPM-key detect. The binary PCM frame is ONLY the audio being written (a bar, a chunk, or the whole track): the server keeps a sample-exact mirror of the source audio and pulls all re-encode context from it, so no context margins, window math, or full-loop re-uploads. JSON header followed by one binary PCM frame: ``<II`` (channels, samples) then interleaved float32 at 48 kHz. Acked by audio_written / audio_write_failed.

at_s.description: Where the buffer's first sample lands on the source, in playback seconds (sample-exact; no frame or grid alignment required). Default 0. Audio past the source end is trimmed, never wrapped.

mix.description: replace = overwrite the span (declicked against the existing audio at the edges); sum = overdub on top of what's there.

refresh_timbre.description: Re-encode the self-timbre conditioning against the updated source (~+50 ms). Ignored when a timbre override is active. Default false.

repeat.description: fill = treat the buffer as ONE period of a loop and lay it across the whole source, phase-anchored at at_s (sample-exact audio-domain tiling; any period length works). Default none = write once.

source_epoch.description: The source generation this write targets (from ready/swap_ready, bumped by every swap). A mismatch is rejected with audio_write_failed instead of splicing into the wrong source. Omit to write against whatever is live.

audio_write_failed.description: Failure ack for write_audio (stale source_epoch, write past the source end, bad mix/repeat, no encode path).

audio_written.description: Ack for write_audio: the (start_s, end_s) playback span whose latent was refreshed (the written audio plus the encoder's receptive-field margin).

source_epoch.description: The source generation the write landed on (matches ready/swap_ready).

command_failed.description: A `requires`-tagged command was rejected because the session's backend lacks the capability (loud failure, never a silent no-op). The command was NOT applied. With only the acestep backend registered this fires solely for LoRA commands on a lora-disabled session.

requires.description: The Capabilities field the command needs and the session's backend doesn't declare.

error.description: Structured init failure (sent during the handshake).

duration_s.description: Present only on the engine_not_built code: the source duration whose TRT profile is missing.

init_ack.description: Optional telemetry ack emitted after config parse but before audio/model init. Sent ONLY when the config opts in via telemetry_version, so old clients never see it.

client_id.description: The config client_id echoed back, or null when the client sent none.

session_id.description: Server-minted session id, sent as soon as log context binds so client startup failures correlate with pod logs.

manual_slot_count.description: Ack for manual_slot_add / manual_slot_pop — emitted on success and refusal alike so the client's +/- UI resyncs either way.

count.description: The live manual steering slot count after the command.

params_echo.description: MCP-driven knob change echoed so the browser mirrors it; the browser's own param updates do not echo.

params_update.description: Periodic echo of the live param/telemetry snapshot.

params.description: Applied params + runtime telemetry (num_gens, tick_ms, dec_ms).

prompt_applied.description: Ack that a prompt re-encode completed.

prompt_blend_echo.description: MCP-driven prompt-blend echo (the dedicated blend slider rides its own channel, not params).

ready.description: First JSON after the upload handshake, followed by the binary float16 initial buffer.

capabilities.description: Backend capability mask: {capability: bool} over the Capabilities fields (swap, timbre, structure, lora, ...). Client panels and MCP tools gate on it; commands tagged with a matching `requires` fail with command_failed when the bit is false.

geometry.description: Backend-declared audio geometry: {sample_rate, channels, chunk_rate_hz, duration_s|null}. chunk_rate_hz is the generation cadence (latent fps for diffusion, frame rate for AR models); duration_s null is reserved for endless streams.

knob_manifest.description: Per-session knob manifest: the same {version, knobs} envelope GET /api/knobs serves, but backend-owned and session-resolved (SDE mode, enabled lora_str_<id> knobs). /api/knobs remains the static pre-session probe.

lora_pending_enable.description: LoRA ids the server will auto-enable on the first tick (from the session's initial enable set); empty when none.

manual_slot_cap.description: Server-imposed ceiling on manual steering slots; gates the client's + button.

manual_slot_count.description: Active manual steering slot count; drives the client's man_*_<N> row rendering. Updated live via the manual_slot_count event.

session_id.description: Server-minted session id, echoed for client/analytics log correlation.

source_epoch.description: Source generation counter (0 at create, bumped by every swap). Echo it in write_audio to pin a write to the source it was computed against.

steering_available.description: True when the session's checkpoint has a reachable steering-vector bundle; false hides the steering surface (the steer_*/man_* knobs are absent from the manifest too).

stem_assets.description: Stem-overlay header; one binary float16 buffer per listed stem follows, in order.

structure_failed.description: Failure ack for any set_structure_* path, and the notice emitted when a swap drops a structure override ("dropped after swap: ...").

build_command.description: Present only when the swap failed on a missing TRT engine: the command to build the profile for the new source's duration.

swap_ready.description: Swap accepted; a binary float16 replacement buffer follows the JSON.

source_epoch.description: Source generation counter after this swap; write_audio sends targeting the old source are rejected.

timbre_failed.description: Failure ack for any set_timbre_* path.

upload_track.description: Init-phase: persist + encode an uploaded track on the pod WITHOUT starting a stream (sent as the FIRST frame in place of the session config). JSON header followed by one binary PCM frame: ``<II`` (channels, samples) then interleaved float32 at 48 kHz. Acked by upload_ok / upload_failed, after which the socket closes.

key.description: Optional key override; forces a re-encode instead of the content-dedup fast path.

time_signature.description: Optional meter override; same effect as key.

upload_ok.description: Init-phase ack: the uploaded track was persisted + encoded (or an identical existing one was reused).

name.description: Final persisted track name (may differ from the requested name after dedup/uniquify).
